admin:cookie:NEXT_LOCALE.note: The locale of the admin request; next-intl 4.13.0 sets it from `apps/admin/proxy.ts` (`createMiddleware(routing)`) when the request's locale differs from the cookie or from Accept-Language, and reads it to choose the locale of a path without one.

admin:cookie:admin-csrf.note: The CSRF token the backend issues at admin login, httpOnly; `lib/auth/sessionCookie.ts` sets and clears it, and the refresh route and the backend proxy send it with the refresh token.

admin:cookie:admin-refresh.note: The admin refresh token, httpOnly; `lib/auth/sessionCookie.ts` sets and clears it, and the refresh route and the backend proxy read it to obtain a new access token.

admin:cookie:admin-session.lifetime: 15 minutes at login; 1 day when the backend proxy refreshes it
admin:cookie:admin-session.note: The admin access token, httpOnly; `lib/auth/sessionCookie.ts` and the backend proxy set it, and the proxy, the dashboard layout and `proxy.ts` read it to authenticate requests.

admin:localStorage:admin-setup-dismissed.note: Whether the admin dismissed the dashboard setup banner; `SetupBanner` writes and reads it.

admin:localStorage:admin-theme.note: The light or dark theme the admin chose; `ThemeProvider` writes and reads it.

api:cookie:refreshToken.lifetime: 7000 days as written: `maxAge` is 604800000, which @fastify/cookie reads as seconds, while the code comment says 7 days
api:cookie:refreshToken.note: The refresh token issued at `/auth` login and the SAML and OIDC callbacks, httpOnly and scoped to `/auth`; token refresh and logout read it, and a failed refresh, logout and revoke-all clear it.

client:cookie:NEXT_LOCALE.note: The locale of the customer request; next-intl 4.13.0 sets it from `apps/client/proxy.ts` (`createMiddleware(routing)`) and from its router when `LanguageSwitcher` changes the locale, and reads it to choose the locale of a path without one.

client:cookie:customer-refresh.note: The customer refresh token, httpOnly; `lib/auth/sessionCookie.ts` sets and clears it, and the backend proxy reads it to refresh the session.

client:cookie:customer-session.note: The customer access token, httpOnly; `lib/auth/sessionCookie.ts` sets and clears it, and the backend proxy and `proxy.ts` read it to authenticate requests.

client:localStorage:dismissed-announceme.note: The ids of the system announcements the user dismissed, as a JSON array; `AnnouncementBanner` writes and reads it.

client:localStorage:omnipost-active-proj.note: The account and project ids the user last selected, as JSON; `ProjectProvider` writes and reads it.

client:localStorage:unresolved:apps/clie.lifetime: until the draft is published or scheduled
client:localStorage:unresolved:apps/clie.note: An unsaved post draft (body, title, tags, project, locale and providers) with its save time; `useAutoSave` writes, reads and removes it, and the editor removes it once the post is published or scheduled.
